name: dev-guardian
description: All-in-one open-source plugin for security, bugfix, code quality, observability and compliance in dev projects. Auto-detects the stack (Node, Python, PHP/WordPress, Go, Rust, Ruby, Java, C#/.NET) and installs/configures open-source tools like Semgrep, Trivy, gitleaks, Renovate, nuclei, Playwright. Pragmatic by default, paranoid when critical.
